_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Spot coil plus demand vacuum and exchange intake rise favor a one-rung slip into Anxiety if the range breaks lower; base rate supports directional moves but conviction stays low until flows confirm.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both lean cautionary/supply-heavy; analyst explicit DOWN to Anxiety, narrative only implies sell-side pressure via intake, no forward phase
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC breaks the coil lower, fear_greed into low 40s, ETF flows pinned near 0, funding flat/negative
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows rebound, spot CVD lifts, price breaks range higher back toward Disbelief
